neighbours.label: the token 'is' completing 'tr|is' (Tris buffer, tris(…) in chemical names, trisomy); 'is' in other words (iris, crisis, Paris) and the word 'is' do not fire. The top examples also hold 'berries' / 'berry' pieces, which fired only once in probes
fire: Cells were lysed in cold Tris buffer containing a mix of protease inhibitors.
Children with trisomy 21 often need extra support with speech in the early years.
The dye was a ruthenium tris(bipyridine) complex dissolved in water.
Each pellet was washed twice with Tris-buffered saline before staining.
The signal depends on inositol trisphosphate released inside the cell.
An extra copy of chromosome 18 causes trisomy 18, a serious condition.
The protein was eluted with 50 mM Tris at pH 8.0 and kept on ice.
The ligand tris(2-aminoethyl)amine binds copper very tightly.
quiet: Cells were lysed in cold phosphate buffer containing a mix of protease inhibitors.
Children with arthritis often need extra support with movement in the early years.
The dye was a ruthenium bis(bipyridine) complex dissolved in water.
Each pellet was washed twice with HEPES-buffered saline before staining.
The signal depends on cyclic AMP released inside the cell.
A missing copy of chromosome 18 causes a rare and serious condition.
The debt crisis in Paris was at its worst during the winter.
The iris of the left eye was a lighter brown than the right.

notes: Card: 'is' x16 of the top 32 (all after 'tr'/'Tr'), 'berries' x7, 'berry' x6. Probes: 'Tris buffer' 0.81, 'tris(bipyridine)' 0.86, 'Tris-acetate' 0.71, 'trisomy 21' 0.48; 'raspberries' 0.42 once but blackberries, gooseberries, cranberry, strawberry all under 0.06; iris, arthritis, crisis, Paris, 'This is' under 0.02.
